lessons.title: Mass, Volume, Weight and Density

explanation_sections.title: Mass, Volume, Weight and Density
explanation_sections.body:
Density = mass ÷ volume; mass = density × volume; volume = mass ÷ density. Mass is the amount of
matter; weight is the gravitational force on an object.

lessons.source_reference: ElimuQuest Mathematics Curriculum Draft v1, PDF p. 12

questions.prompt: A block has mass 600 g and volume 200 cm³. Find density.
A substance has density 2.5 g/cm³ and volume 80 cm³. Find mass.
Explain the difference between mass and weight.
questions.correct_answer: Mass is measured in kilograms; weight is a force measured in newtons.
